title: bug: scripts/verify-release-version.mjs checks 4 version fields (daemon, proxy and VS Code package.json, plus build.gradle.kts), but docs/RELEASING.md:7-13 lists the package-lock.json versions and moe-claude-plugin too and says the workflow "stops on a mismatch", so a lockfile or claude-plugin drift would tag cleanly; moe-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and installer/moe-installer.iss still read 0.1.0, outside both
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 from hunt #23's held-back item (task-da51c48b, architect-cd0ac706, #governors msg-baeb96b3). The governor re-verified it at origin/moe/work-2026-10-24.

PROBLEM
- scripts/verify-release-version.mjs:10-16 compares only packages/moe-daemon/package.json, packages/moe-proxy/package.json, moe-vscode/package.json and build.gradle.kts `version =` with the tag.
- docs/RELEASING.md:7-13 says all package versions are kept in sync and lists more fields:
  - each package-lock.json's top-level `version` **and** `packages[""].version`, for daemon, proxy, claude-plugin and vscode;
  - packages/moe-claude-plugin/package.json.
  RELEASING.md:22 then says "The workflow runs the same check first and stops on a mismatch". CLAUDE.md:86 says releases have "all package versions synced".
- Today every listed field reads 0.8.0, so nothing ships wrong yet, but the guard would pass a release whose lockfiles or claude-plugin version drifted.
- Two version strings sit outside both the list and the guard:
  - packages/moe-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json `"version": "0.1.0"`;
  - installer/moe-installer.iss:3 `AppVersion=0.1.0`.
  release.yml builds neither of them (per the hunt).

FIX DIRECTION
- Extend the guard to every field RELEASING.md lists: the four lockfiles' two fields each, and claude-plugin package.json.
- Decide the two stragglers explicitly. Either bring them into the sync, by guarding and bumping them to the current version, or name them in RELEASING.md as deliberately unsynced, with the reason. CLAUDE.md's "all package versions synced" favours syncing them.
- Extend scripts/tests/release-version.mjs, or its runner, with cases that fail on a lockfile mismatch and a claude-plugin mismatch.

SCOPE AND CHECKS
- scripts/verify-release-version.mjs, scripts/tests/release-version.mjs and docs/RELEASING.md, plus the two straggler files only if they are synced.
- At filing time no open row holds them.
- Verify by running `node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs v0.8.0` in a snapshot (PASS), then its test file. Never tag or publish anything.
definitionOfDone: verify-release-version.mjs fails on a mismatch in any field docs/RELEASING.md lists (each package-lock.json's top-level and packages[""] version, and moe-claude-plugin/package.json), and the test file has failing-then-passing cases for a lockfile and a claude-plugin mismatch.

moe-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and installer/moe-installer.iss are either synced and guarded, or named in RELEASING.md as deliberately unsynced with the reason. RELEASING.md's list matches what the guard checks.
`node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs v0.8.0` prints PASS at the row's tip, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
scripts/verify-release-version.mjs: extend the guard to every field docs/RELEASING.md lists, plus the two stragglers step 2 syncs. Edit with the editing tool.

KEEP THE CLI. It takes one tag argument and keeps the same tag regex. On success it prints `PASS release versions: X.Y.Z` to stdout and exits 0. Otherwise it prints every mismatch to stderr and exits 1.

FIELDS, in this order, each with a label:
- For each of packages/moe-daemon, packages/moe-proxy, packages/moe-claude-plugin and moe-vscode, three fields:
  - `<dir>/package.json` (its version);
  - `<dir>/package-lock.json version` (the top-level version);
  - `<dir>/package-lock.json packages[""].version`.
- `packages/moe-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (its version).
- `moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts`, read with the existing `version = "..."` multiline regex.
- `installer/moe-installer.iss`, read with a multiline match of a line `AppVersion=<non-space version>` followed only by optional whitespace, so a CRLF copy still reads.

SHAPE. Keep it table-driven: one entry per field ({label, file, read}). Parse each JSON file once. A single-field file's label is its path, so the existing rows' `stderr.includes(file)` still holds. No package.json path is a substring of its package-lock.json path. Message format, unchanged: `<label>: found <v>, expected <X.Y.Z>`. No new dependency: node:fs only.

Error handling: a missing, unreadable or malformed file, or a missing field, never throws a stack. It becomes that field's line, `<label>: found undefined, expected X.Y.Z` or `<label>: unreadable, expected X.Y.Z`. Every mismatch is reported in one run (exit 1), not just the first. The existing try/catch stays as the last-resort guard for the tag check.
implementationPlan.note: Guard now table-driven over 15 fields (4 pkgs x 3, plugin.json, gradle, iss); per-field unreadable/mismatch lines, all reported in one run.

implementationPlan.description:
Sync the two stragglers to the release version, 0.8.0 today:
- packages/moe-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json: `"version": "0.1.0"` becomes `"version": "0.8.0"`;
- installer/moe-installer.iss line 3: `AppVersion=0.1.0` becomes `AppVersion=0.8.0`.
Change nothing else in either file. Edit with the editing tool and keep LF endings (.gitattributes forces eol=lf).

Why sync instead of exempting them:
- CLAUDE.md says releases have all package versions synced.
- plugin.json is the claude-plugin package's own manifest, already at 0.8.0 in its package.json.
- The installer's AppVersion is the version Windows lists for the installed app.
- scripts/build-installer.ps1 and ISCC inject no version, release.yml never rewrites either file, and no test pins 0.1.0, so nothing depends on the old value.

Error handling: none needed at runtime. Step 3's per-field rows and the repo row fail if either file drifts again.

scripts/tests/release-version.mjs, the node:test file CI runs (`node --test scripts/tests/release-version.mjs`, ci.yml:238).

FIXTURE. fixture() writes every guarded file at 0.8.0:
- the four package.json files (claude-plugin added);
- the four package-lock.json files as {name, version, lockfileVersion: 3, packages: {"": {name, version}}};
- plugin.json as {name: 'moe', version};
- build.gradle.kts as `version = "0.8.0"`;
- moe-installer.iss as a [Setup] section with AppName=Moe and AppVersion=0.8.0.
The test writes its own field list out by hand, one entry per field with a mutator, and never imports it from the guard. A field dropped from the guard then fails its row.

ROWS:
- FAILING THEN PASSING, for every field. Mutate only that field to 0.6.0 -> exit 1; stderr names its label with `found 0.6.0, expected 0.8.0` and names no other field's label. Then restore it -> exit 0 with `PASS release versions: 0.8.0`. This is DoD 1's failing-then-passing case for both lockfile fields of each package, and for claude-plugin's package.json and plugin.json.
- Two mismatched fields at once are both reported in one run (exit 1).
- Error handling: a deleted packages/moe-claude-plugin/package-lock.json and a non-JSON plugin.json each exit 1, naming the file, with no stack trace (no stderr line matching /^\s+at /).
- The existing malformed-tag test stays.
- A REPO ROW runs the guard with cwd = the repository root (resolved from import.meta.url) and the tag 'v' + packages/moe-daemon/package.json's version, and expects PASS. CI then fails on drift before any tag exists.

Every fixture stays under os.tmpdir() and is removed (keep the existing finally and its tmpdir assert).

Verification, once, from the task worktree root. Run checkRefs[0] exactly and submit its fresh exit code and output tail with moe.complete_task:

bash -c 'S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$S" && { git diff --quiet HEAD || git diff HEAD --binary | git -C "$S" apply; } && (cd "$S" && node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs v0.8.0 && node --test scripts/tests/release-version.mjs); rc=$?; rm -rf "$S"; exit $rc'

The command builds a snapshot outside the shared checkout: an archive of HEAD plus W's uncommitted diff. In it, the guard must print `PASS release versions: 0.8.0` (DoD 3) and every node:test row must pass.

Error handling for a red run:
- A FAIL line names the field. Fix the guard, the fixture or the straggler.
- Never weaken a row.
- Never tag, push a tag or publish anything.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of this diff, the final step. Use the adversarial-self-review skill.

1. DOCS MATCH THE GUARD. Diff the RELEASING.md list against the guard's table: same files, same fields, same order.
2. PROVE THE ROWS. Delete each lockfile field from the guard one at a time in a scratch copy (never in W): its row must fail. Then restore it.
3. STRAGGLERS. `git grep -n 0.1.0` over installer/ and packages/moe-claude-plugin/ is empty.
4. NO STACK TRACES. A missing file, malformed JSON, a missing packages[""] key and a CRLF .iss each give a one-line verdict, never a stack trace.
5. TAG RULE. The tag regex and the PASS text are byte-identical, because release.yml:42 and the docs depend on them.

Record the findings in the step note.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review: RELEASING.md list matches guard table order; git grep 0.1.0 over installer/ and claude-plugin empty; in a scratch copy, dropping packages[""] lines, lockfile version lines or plugin.json/iss entries from the guard fails the matching rows (6/7/4 fails); missing file, bad JSON, missing packages[""] and CRLF iss give one-line verdicts; tag regex and PASS text unchanged.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: `node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs vX.Y.Z` fails, naming each field, when any of these differs from X.Y.Z: the daemon, proxy, claude-plugin or vscode package.json; any of their package-lock.json files' top-level `version` or `packages[""].version`; moe-claude-plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json; build.gradle.kts `version`; or moe-installer.iss `AppVersion`. When all match it prints `PASS release versions: X.Y.Z`. The two stragglers are synced to 0.8.0, and RELEASING.md lists exactly the guarded fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Every guarded field has a test row that fails with that field named and then passes once restored. This includes both lockfile fields of all four packages and claude-plugin's package.json and plugin.json.
A missing or malformed guarded file exits 1 with a one-line verdict, never a stack trace. Two mismatches are both reported in one run.
plugin.json and moe-installer.iss read 0.8.0 and are guarded. RELEASING.md's list equals the guard's table, and the session mods are named as deliberately unsynced, with the reason.
checkRefs[0] passes: the guard prints PASS for v0.8.0 in a snapshot outside the shared checkout, and every node:test row passes.
invariants: The CLI keeps its contract: one tag argument, the same tag regex, `PASS release versions: X.Y.Z` with exit 0, otherwise exit 1 with the mismatches on stderr.
The test's field list is independent of the guard's, so dropping a field from the guard fails a row.
Nothing is tagged, pushed or published.
compatibility: release.yml:42 (`node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"`) and ci.yml:238 (`node --test scripts/tests/release-version.mjs`) are unchanged.
Messages for the existing four fields keep the `<file>: found <v>, expected <X.Y.Z>` shape.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Exempt the two stragglers in RELEASING.md instead of syncing them: rejected. CLAUDE.md says all package versions are synced, and neither file has a reason to differ (nothing injects or reads them).
- Sync the session mods' plugin.json too: rejected. They are internal mods inside the IDE bundles, never released on their own. The docs name them as unsynced.
- Import the field list into the test: rejected, because a field dropped from the guard would then go unnoticed.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- release.yml:42 runs the guard on the tag, and ci.yml:238 runs the test file.
- Every lockfile carries both a top-level version and packages[""].version.
- installer/moe-installer.iss is LF, as .gitattributes forces. Its version is a plain AppVersion= line, built by hand with ISCC.
- The claude-plugin package.json is already 0.8.0; only its .claude-plugin/plugin.json lags.
planningNotes.risks:
- The repo row ties CI to the real tree. A partial version bump on a PR is red until every field matches, which is the point.
- Keep error handling one-line: a stack trace on a missing file would hide which field failed.
- The snapshot command applies W's uncommitted diff onto an archive of HEAD. The plan adds no new files, so `git diff HEAD` covers every change.
